messages:
Maria Chen: Quick check — I put two onboarding mockups in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/onboard-v2. TL;DR: Option A = persistent left-hand 'Setup checklist' card in Console (progress + resume). Option B = ephemeral top 'Quickstart spotlight' banner with a 3-card sample-project carousel. Which one do we think reduces time-to-first-success? Also opinions on copy: 'Try a sample project' vs 'Start with a template'?

Dev Shah: I lean persistent checklist. Engineers come back to it. Banners are great for one-off clicks but they disappear and then people get lost. Also need a clear keyboard 'Skip' and 'Resume checklist' states.

Lena Park: Agree we should A/B both. Track activation metrics: create-api-key, first-api-call, time-to-first-token. Banner might lift immediate clicks; checklist might help completion rate over 24–72h.

Priya N: Copy note — 'Get started with a sample app' performs better in tests than 'Start with a template'. Add reassurance microcopy: 'No infra, sandboxed demo data'.

Aaron Liu: Accessibility nits: carousel must not trap keyboard focus; arrows need focusable buttons with visible focus ring. Ensure CTA contrast >= 4.5:1, and announce position like 'Card 2 of 3' to SR. For checklist, each step should be a real button, not just a div, so screen readers see actionable items.

Maria Chen: Good call, Aaron — I'll annotate Figma with aria labels and focus order. Also thinking of a small 'Playground' action that preloads a demo workspace + a one-minute guided tooltip tour.

Dev Shah: Implementation notes — checklist can be client-persisted (local storage keyed by user_id) with server fallback to remember across devices. Sample projects should live in a demo namespace we can wipe/reset. Add a 'Reset demo' button in Settings for power users.

Lena Park: For evaluation, let's define events: onboarding.shown, onboarding.banner_clicked, onboarding.checklist_opened, onboarding.sample_launched, onboarding.completed. Segment by org size and role.

deploy-bot: Feature flag ready: onboarding_ui_v2 toggled on staging for 10% of new signups starting 2025-06-10.

Priya N: Quick copy tweak suggestion: change CTA from 'Try sample project' to 'Launch demo app' — more action-oriented.

Maria Chen: Thanks — I'll update Figma and upload two annotated variants for staging. Plan: run a 48-hour micro A/B on staging and decide default by EOD Friday. Please drop any last accessibility/copy nits here. :thumbsup:
